HP skill: area damage equal to 2.5% of current HP. Removes berserk buffs and deals additional damage. Upgrade 4 strengthens Black Vortex.

units.name: Nami
units.note: Command: nami tr (Clear Weather). Normal; triggered movement slow 45; total-HP damage; magic damage amplification 2; gold income +20%; Upgrade 4.

units.name: Law
units.note: Command: law tr (The Man Who Offered One Hundred Hearts). Piercing; triggered movement slow 35; explosion damage; current-HP damage; single-target boss slow 99; additional damage against berserk enemies. Mana skill: movement slow 45 and attack +20; Upgrade 4.

units.name: Lucci
units.note: Command: lucci tr (White Bird Pursuing Dark Justice). Siege; single-target magic damage (values 23, 40); single-target stun; explosion damage amplification +10%. Upgrade 4 awakens the Devil Fruit.

units.name: Brook
units.note: Command: brook tr (Soul King). Normal; movement slow 15; global slow 5; magic resistance reduction 3; finisher; single-target stun; creep-related effect; flying. Mana skill: magic damage amplification 8 and stun 3s. Upgrade 4 summons Baby Laboon.

units.name: Sanji
units.note: Command: sanji tr (The Man Returned from Hell). Siege; single-target magic damage; triggered movement slow 50 (55); mana skill; flying; blink range 800; Upgrade 4.

units.name: Shanks
units.note: Command: shanks tr (The Man Who Ended the Paramount War). Haki; stun 2s; Haki stun; mana skill; single-target stun; self attack speed +20. Upgrade 4 unlocks Divine Departure; additional damage against berserk enemies. Departure can defeat Burgess with some luck.

units.name: Snakeman
units.note: Command: snakeman tr (Fifth Emperor). Haki; explosion damage; mana skill; single-target stun; flying; damage increases with enemy movement speed. Upgrade 4 extends resistance-ignoring single-target stun by 0.5s and adds boss/berserk damage.

units.name: Shirahoshi
units.note: Command: shirahoshi tr (Mermaid Princess Who Rules the Sea Kings). Normal; stun 1.2s; splash; flying. Mana skill: area damage equal to 6% of missing HP multiplied by 1-1.5, and stun 3s; special upgrade available.

units.name: Aokiji
units.note: Command: aokiji tr (Former Marine Admiral Blue Pheasant). Piercing; stun 1.2s; movement slow 70 (80); single-target slow 15; mana skill. Upgrade 4 adds slow 10, explosion damage amplification 5, flying, and self mana regeneration.

units.name: Akainu
units.note: Command: akainu tr (Marine Fleet Admiral Red Dog). Siege; triggered movement slow 12; HP and mana skills; single-target stun; triggered magic resistance reduction 10; additional damage against berserk enemies. One skill does not stack with Eternal Ace. Upgrade 4 adjusts meteor density and adds strength-based damage.

units.name: Kid
units.note: Command: kid tr (Heretic of the New Generation). Siege; movement slow 35; HP skill; area stun 0.18s; single-target stun. Deals more damage to clustered enemies; Upgrade 4.

units.name: Kizaru
units.note: Command: kizaru tr (Marine Admiral Yellow Monkey). Piercing; stun 0.9s; mana skill; single-target stun; blink range 3500; special upgrade available.

units.name: Franky
units.note: Command: franky tr (Invincible Iron Pirates). Siege; mana regeneration 5 excluding self. Mana skill: General Franky transformation lasting 6s. Damage increases per nearby Sunny. Shipwright can craft 2 Sunny ships; source title lists cost 8 wood, description lists 10 wood. Upgrade 4.

units.name: Koby
units.note: Command: koby tr (Future of the Marines). Summons clones; source title lists explosion damage and description lists armor-ignoring damage. Flying; lane explosion-damage reduction debuff 10%; self attack speed increases every 5 rounds, up to level 6; Upgrade 4.

units.name: Rebecca
units.note: Piercing; armor reduction 38; triggered movement slow 50; splash; leveling; single-target stun. Additional crafting cost: 5,000 gold and 5 wood. Upgrade 4 adds Repeated Training; gains 2 levels when using the mana skill.

units.name: Katakuri
units.note: Siege; armor reduction 30; HP regeneration 2.85; 75% area damage; HP skill; single-target stun. Additional crafting cost: 35,000 gold and 5 wood. Every attack deals 6x critical damage to bosses/story enemies; 20% Haki proc grants Armor Break 6. Upgrade 4 enhances skills.

units.name: Crocodile
units.note: Piercing; stun 0.54s (0.6s upgraded); movement slow 40; armor reduction 25. Additional crafting cost: 5,000 gold and 5 wood. Upgrade 4 adds Armor Break and a short-stun skill.

units.name: Alvida
units.note: Armor reduction 25; mana skill: missing-HP damage, Armor Break 10, and area stun; guaranteed single-target stun; all skills knock back. Crafting consumes 4 additional special upgrade points.

units.name: Marco
units.note: Piercing; movement slow 45; HP regeneration 3; splash; single-target damage; HP skill; flying. Human form: single-target explosion damage equal to 20% of current HP. Phoenix form: area splash and 3x physical critical damage. Additional crafting cost: 5,000 gold and 5 wood. Upgrade 4 raises HP regeneration to 4 and slow to 60.

units.name: Redfield
units.note: Haki; total-HP damage; magic finisher; single-target stun; blink range 1500. Additional crafting cost: 5,000 gold and 5 wood; can only be crafted before round 41. Upgrade 4 adds the Blood Explosion skill.

units.name: Shinobu
units.note: Normal; movement slow 30; finisher; HP skill; single-target stun; additional damage against berserk enemies. Additional crafting cost: 5,000 gold and 5 wood. Upgrade 4 strengthens clones.

units.name: Ain
units.note: Piercing; reduces enemy level and deletes enemies; blink range 1500; additional damage against berserk enemies; special upgrade available. Requires 3 Absalom, 5,000 gold, and 5 wood in addition to the other recipe ingredients.

units.note: Normal; mana regeneration 1.5; single-target stun and total-HP damage; additional damage against berserk enemies. Mana skill: area damage equal to 2% of total HP, magic resistance reduction 18, and stun 3s. Additional crafting cost: 5,000 gold and 5 wood. Normal upgrades strengthen skills; Upgrade 4 enhances Discharge.

units.name: Garp
units.note: Command: garp im (Marine Hero Garp). Siege; stun 1.1s; armor +15; percentage area damage; single-target physical damage; damage increases per buff; single-target stun. Mana skill: area damage equal to 5% of total HP.

units.name: Rayleigh
units.note: Command: rayleigh im (Dark King Silvers Rayleigh). Piercing; armor reduction 20 (25); attack speed +45; 100% area damage; persuades allied units; single-target stun. Mana skill: Armor Break 5, stun 3s, and allied-unit persuasion. Can sell junk; special upgrade available.

units.name: Roger
units.note: Command: roger im (Pirate King Gol D. Roger). Haki; movement slow 50; armor reduction 60; attack +60; single-target stun. Mana skill: movement slow 115; special upgrade: Divine Departure.

units.name: Gaban
units.note: Mountain Eater; Piercing; single-target armor reduction 60; mana skill: finisher; single-target stun. Special upgrade adds attack-buff-based extra hits and additional boss armor reduction. Upgrade 4 enhances skills and adds high-speed movement.

units.name: Kaido
units.note: Command: kaido im (King of the Beasts). Haki; movement slow 60; splash; percentage area damage; single-target armor reduction 45; F: transformation; HP skill; flying. units.name: Whitebeard

units.note: Command: bullet im (Heir of the Monster). Single-target stun; feeding Common units randomly enhances items.

units.note: Command: dragon im (Wind That Brings the Storm). Normal; stun 1.4s; attack speed +20; mana skill; skill damage scales with attack speed; explosion damage amplification +20% against normal lane enemies. Upgrade 4: automatic deletion every 9s. Without the upgrade, requires Docking twice to defeat Burgess. Cutting Wind is a single-target skill dealing 40% less damage to non-lane enemies.

units.note: Gluttonous Iron Balloon; Siege; movement slow 70; 66% area magic damage; flying. HP skill: area damage equal to 1% of total HP, 7 hits. One Docking allows defeating Burgess; special upgrade available.

units.note: Command: hancock et (Empress of Amazon Lily). Upgrade 4 strengthens stun, adds area explosion damage, and adds armor reduction 5.
